entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. You're speaking with Diana at VeloFit. How can I help you today?
Finally! This is absolutely ridiculous. I need to return this VeloBand tracker right now. I have been trying for weeks!

I'm very sorry to hear you've had a frustrating experience. I can definitely look into that for you. To make sure I understand correctly, what specifically is the issue with the band? Is it a technical fault or a preference?
It doesn't matter! It's not what I wanted. I tried to return it way back on December 24th, well inside any normal return window, but your entire website was down!
I see. I can certainly understand your frustration with that. Let me check our records for that date. So you're saying you encountered a website error?

A 'website error'? The whole system was down! It was completely useless. I couldn't get the return page to load, so obviously I couldn't print a label. I was so angry I even took a screenshot because I knew you people would pull something like this!

Thank you for that detail. One moment while I check our system status logs... Yes, I am seeing a note confirming we had a major site-wide outage that day. I sincerely apologize that you were impacted by that. It should not have happened.
Apologies don't do anything. Are you going to process this return or do I need to talk to your manager? I'm a VIP member, and I'm one step away from blasting VeloFit all over social media.

That won't be necessary, I can resolve this for you right now. I'm pulling up your order, and I see you received the VeloBand 23 days ago. Let me just check the policy... Okay, I see here that our policy allows for returns within 90 days of delivery. So you are well within the timeframe.
90 days? Whatever. Just get it done. I want the email with the return label before we hang up.

Of course. I have just processed the full refund and approved the return. The email with the pre-paid shipping label is being sent to you as we speak. And for the trouble caused by our system being down, and as a thank you for your loyalty as a VIP member, I've also added a $100 credit to your VeloFit account.
A hundred dollars? And the return is processed? Okay. Fine. That's acceptable. Just make sure that email actually shows up.
It has just been sent from my system. You should see it within the next few minutes. Is there anything else I can help you with today?
Alright. Well, thank you for your patience today. We appreciate your business at VeloFit. Have a great day.
